actions.text: Committee on Veterans' Affairs. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Committee on Veterans' Affairs. Hearings held. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 119-86.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Affects rural veterans, tribal organizations, Native Hawaiian organizations, and veterans service organizations eligible for VA transportation grants.
Increases accessibility to transportation grants, sets standard grant maximums at $50,000 with potential 50 percent increases for certain isolated counties, and expands eligible recipient entities.
dimensions.evidence: the amount of a grant under this section may not exceed $50,000

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes 'such sums as may be necessary' for fiscal years 2025 through 2029 to fund the transportation grant program, replacing previous caps of $3,000,000 annually.
dimensions.evidence: inserting such sums as may be necessary for each of fiscal years 2025 through 2029

dimensions.assessment: Amends an existing VA health services and transportation grant program statute by expanding eligible entities and adjusting award limits.
dimensions.evidence: Section 307 of the Caregivers and Veterans Omnibus Health Services Act of 2010... is amended

dimensions.assessment: Extends the grant program authority through fiscal year 2029.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2025 through 2029

missing_information: Exact projected total spending amounts under the 'such sums as may be necessary' authorization.
importance_detail.rationale: The Supporting Rural Veterans Access to Healthcare Services Act extends and expands the VA transportation grant program to include tribal and Native Hawaiian organizations, modifies grant caps, and authorizes necessary appropriations.
